reason: The hypothesis makes specific claims about the relationship between atomic size mismatch, local lattice distortions, phonon frequencies, electron–phonon coupling, and T_c in high-entropy alloys, but cites no prior evidence to support any of these premises. Standard textbook knowledge covers the general link between electron–phonon coupling and T_c, but the specific application to local distortions in multi-element solid solutions and the effect of annealing on such distortions require cited support, which is absent.
premises: Larger atomic size mismatches create local lattice distortions
Local lattice distortions lower phonon frequencies
Lower phonon frequencies enhance electron–phonon coupling
